resources.string: Optional light signals. Quiet hours, battery limits and face-down restrictions still apply. Notification access is needed for DND and incoming calls.

While plugged in, blink for 2 seconds every 15 seconds. At your charged level, show a steady color for 2 seconds instead. Signals may pause while the phone sleeps or another alert is playing. When Respect DND is enabled, charging signals pause until notification access supplies the current DND status.
Pulse for 2 seconds when Do Not Disturb switches on, including Flip to Shhh when it activates DND. This activation signal can play during DND.
Signal Android notifications explicitly marked as incoming calls. Support depends on the calling app; not every phone or internet calling app supplies this information.
